label: Synthetic plan and usage demo
scope: Static plans, allowances and subscription-state proposals; no provider call, purchase or implementation

household.identityNote: Aliases identify synthetic accounts. Administration and payment are distinct responsibilities.

sample.stateRelationship: Independent earlier alternative for the same three-member household, before paid activation
sample.webPresentation: Sample status and a clearly labeled pilot-reference Family offer
sample.nativePresentation: Neutral current Sample status and limits; no Family upsell or purchase promotion

family.dateNote: Provider billing renewal and verified access dates are independent from the usage-window reset. No provider timestamp is inferred from the date-only billing fixture.

offer.priceStatus: Pilot reference prices; not a current localized quote
offer.requiredDisclosure: Confirm actual price, taxes, billing period and renewal terms in Polar before purchase.

allowancePolicy.welcomeApplies: First paid usage month only; replaces the regular 50-page allowance, not added to it
allowancePolicy.windowAnchor: Original paid activation; clamp short months from the original calendar-day anchor
allowancePolicy.failedJobs: Release reservations once; no completed usage charge
allowancePolicy.technicalRetries: No additional user unit; preserve logical operation identity
allowancePolicy.explicitFailedJobRetry: Reacquire available capacity for the same logical job
allowancePolicy.deliberateReprocessing: New requested action; disclose its allowance cost before submission

checkout.stateRelationship: Independent eligible attempt from the Sample alternative, not a second purchase while main Family access is active
checkout.priceStatus: EUR 39/year pilot reference; actual offer and terms require confirmation in Polar

pending.stateRelationship: Return/checking state of the independent eligible checkout attempt
pending.priorAccess: Sample access remains until a verified entitlement change

cancel.state: Confirmation before requesting cancellation of renewal

archive.stateRelationship: Synthetic future alternative after verified expiry, not the current clock or a consequence inferred solely from a local date
preserved: Check and uncheck existing shopping items, including offline

payerChange.purchaseAllowedOnlyAfter: Verified end of old coverage and a new explicit purchase by Sam

imageLimit.stateRelationship: Independent resource-limit alternative in the current regular paid window

refreshError.note: Last known state is labeled as such; the screen does not claim newly verified access or invent expiry after a failed request.

constraints: Only an authenticated designated payer may start or manage their purchase on web.
All members can see usage; non-payers need a separate role-specific view without payment details or management actions.
Native screens contain no prices, external-checkout links, commercial Polar action, QR code, store restore or purchase promotion.
Sample, checkout, active, cancellation, Archive, grace and failure alternatives are not one continuous timeline.
Reservations are not consumed units, and releasing a reservation is not a monetary refund.
One purchase retains its original personal payer and household binding; refresh or membership changes cannot move it.
No actual quote, payment, cancellation, provider lifecycle or T28 implementation is proved by a static fixture.
No real provider IDs, tokens, checkout URLs, payment details or private identities are used.
No application implementation or new DESIGN.md approval is authorized.
T03, T09 and both readiness gates retain their existing status.
